name: Fyxer
tagline: An AI executive assistant that triages email, drafts replies, and takes meeting notes.
description: An AI executive assistant for Gmail and Outlook that organizes your inbox by urgency, drafts replies in your own writing style, and produces meeting notes from Google Meet, Teams, and Zoom calls. Setup is one click via Google or Microsoft sign-in, and drafts improve as it learns from your edits. Plans start at $30/month per seat after a 7-day trial.
insight: Built on 500,000+ hours of workflow data from the founders' prior executive-assistant agency; raised a $30M Madrona-led Series B in 2025.
edge: Drafts that genuinely match your voice and automatic inbox triage, trained on real executive-assistant workflows rather than generic templates.
cons: Per-seat pricing adds up for teams

references.title: Fyxer.ai raises $30M to bring AI productivity assistants to professionals
